entities.summary: Kensaku Shimaki was the pen name of Asakura Kikuo , a Japanese author active during the Shōwa period in Japan. He had an interest in leftist ideology and was arrested in 1928 due to his ties to the Japanese Communist Party. Throughout his literary career, Shimaki wrote multiple novels and stories with a common theme being proletariat life. Some of his works were published by magazines and journals. He associated with Nobel laureate Kawabata Yasunari. Shimaki Kensaku was a authors & novelists from Sapporo (1903-09-07, Sapporo–1945-08-17). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
